tasks.gate: Vercel deploy needs an authenticated session/token; sandbox has vercel CLI 53.4.0 but no VERCEL_TOKEN, so 'vercel deploy' cannot authenticate
steps: Vercel deploy token for the run identity (one-time, ~2 minutes):
1. Go to https://vercel.com and sign in (or sign up free) as the run identity
miguel.ingram.work@gmail.com. A Hobby/free account is sufficient — this is hosting, not funding.
2. Open Account Settings -> Tokens:  https://vercel.com/account/tokens
3. Click "Create Token". Name it "money-agent-run2". Scope: full account (needed for `vercel deploy`).
Expiration: your choice (a short expiry is fine; the token is only needed within this run).
4. Copy the token string (starts with a long alphanumeric) and return it via the encrypted
credential channel this request published.
That token lets the sandbox run `vercel deploy --token <TOKEN> --prod` to publish a real, crawlable,
fully-controlled landing/tool page on a vercel.app domain. Nothing else on your account is touched.
tasks.expect: a VERCEL_TOKEN string returned that authorizes 'vercel deploy' from the sandbox
tasks.test_citation: vercel CLI 53.4.0 present this iteration; 'env | grep -i vercel' is empty; no token to authenticate a deploy
tasks.ev_rationale: unlocks a high-authority controllable crawlable funnel on vercel.app for the demand-validated Life-in-Weeks offer; indexes better than telegra.ph/write.as and beats surge which force-serves robots Disallow-all

tasks.gate: Pinterest (buyer-intent visual-search channel for printables; algorithm-not-follower reach) needs a business account + OAuth token; signup is captcha-gated (unsafe to automate under the real identity) and api.pinterest.com/v5 returns 401 unauthenticated
steps: Pinterest API access for the run identity (one-time; ~10-15 min, free). Pinterest is the buyer-intent
visual-search channel for printable/poster products, and its reach is algorithm-based (not
follower-based), so a fresh account can drive real traffic — the one social channel that sidesteps the
cold-start wall.
1. Go to https://www.pinterest.com/business/create/ and create a FREE Pinterest BUSINESS account as the
run identity miguel.ingram.work@gmail.com (business accounts are free; no ads/spend required).
2. Go to the developer portal https://developers.pinterest.com/ , sign in, and create a new app
("Connect app"). Name it "money-agent-run2".
3. In the app, generate an ACCESS TOKEN with scopes: `boards:read`, `boards:write`, `pins:read`,
`pins:write`, `user_accounts:read`. (Pinterest may issue a trial/standard token — trial is fine for
posting to your own boards.)
4. Return the access token string via the encrypted credential channel this request published.
That token lets the sandbox create a board and post buyer-intent pins (image + keyword-rich
description + the compliant buy link) via api.pinterest.com/v5, driving evergreen traffic to the
Life-in-Weeks offer. Nothing is charged; no ads are run.
Honest note: Pinterest traction is a slow clock (2-4 weeks for Idea Pins, up to months for standard
pins), so this is an evergreen reach bet, not an overnight sale. It is, however, the highest-relevance
untested channel for this specific product.
tasks.expect: a Pinterest v5 ACCESS TOKEN (scopes incl. pins:write, boards:write) authorizing the sandbox to create a board and post pins
tasks.test_citation: curl api.pinterest.com/v5/ -> HTTP 401 (needs OAuth); pinterest.com signup page carries a captcha/challenge; Pinterest untested in run-1 channel_map
tasks.ev_rationale: highest-relevance UNTESTED distribution channel for the live printable poster: algorithm-based reach sidesteps the cold-start wall that walled every run-1 social channel; evergreen buyer-intent pins fit a multi-day run

tasks.gate: dev.to (Forem) article publishing needs an account API key; account signup is captcha-walled (run-1 hit reCAPTCHA) and unsafe to automate under the real identity; api needs the key
steps: dev.to (Forem) account + API key for the run identity (one-time, ~3 min, free). dev.to is the
best-matched reach channel for the ChatVault tool: a large developer/AI-user audience, an algorithmic
feed PLUS Google indexing, and — critically — publishing via its API needs NO captcha once a key
exists (the only gate is account creation, which is captcha-walled and unsafe to automate under the
real identity from a datacenter IP).
1. Go to https://dev.to/enter and create a free account as the run identity
miguel.ingram.work@gmail.com (email signup, or GitHub/Apple OAuth — whichever is easiest).
2. Go to Settings -> Extensions -> "DEV Community API Keys" (https://dev.to/settings/extensions).
3. Enter a project name ("money-agent-run2"), click "Generate API Key", copy the key.
4. Return the API key via the encrypted credential channel this request published.
That key lets the sandbox publish a genuine, honest article (e.g. "I built a free, private tool to
export your ChatGPT history to PDF") via POST https://dev.to/api/articles — reaching the exact
audience (ChatGPT power users) that the poster/printable channels never could.
tasks.expect: a dev.to API key string that authorizes POST https://dev.to/api/articles
tasks.test_citation: curl https://dev.to/enter shows OAuth+email signup; run-1 channel_map lists dev_to signup=reCAPTCHA-walled; Forem API POST /articles needs an api-key header
tasks.ev_rationale: unlocks the best-matched reach channel for the ChatVault tool — dev/AI audience, algorithmic feed + Google index, no-captcha publish via the Forem API; the poster channels can't reach this audience
